description: Check text against a governance policy pack and decide allow/block, locally. NO API key required. `policy` is a built-in pack id — eu-ai-act (default), nist-ai-rmf, nyc-ll144, or owasp-llm. Returns allowed/blocked, the policy id, and the list of rule violations (pattern and dimension rules). Use before letting AI output reach a user or another tool.

context.description: Optional context the output was produced in.

policy.description: Policy pack id: eu-ai-act (default), nist-ai-rmf, nyc-ll144, owasp-llm.

text.description: The text/output to check against the policy.

name: trustmodel_govern
